name: Dxd_CustomUI_ExpandableCard
label: Expandable Card
description: Read-only information card with an icon, collapsed summary, and configurable Pega views.

properties.name: header
properties.description: Heading beside the avatar. Accepts static text or a resolved property value.
properties.label: Header

properties.name: iconName
properties.description: Material UI icon export name for the header avatar. Invalid names use InfoOutlined.
properties.label: Avatar icon (Material UI export name)

properties.name: foregroundColor
properties.description: Hexadecimal header icon and text color, independent of the subheader. Defaults to pure black.
properties.label: Icon and header color (hex)

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: Hexadecimal header avatar background only. Header text has no background. Defaults to light gray (#E9EEF3) to contrast with a white card.
properties.label: Header avatar background color (hex)

properties.name: subHeaderMode
properties.description: Display the subheader as plain text or an installed IconBadge widget.
properties.label: Subheader format

properties.name: subHeaderText
properties.description: Optional subheader text or badge label. Accepts static text or a resolved property value.
properties.label: Subheader text or badge label

properties.name: subHeaderBadgeComponent
properties.description: Registered component key for the IconBadge widget. Missing widgets fall back to text.
properties.label: Registered IconBadge component key

properties.name: subHeaderIconName
properties.description: Material UI icon export name for the subheader badge only.
properties.label: Subheader badge icon

properties.name: subHeaderForegroundColor
properties.description: Hexadecimal subheader text and badge icon color. Defaults to black independently of the header.
properties.label: Subheader foreground color (hex)

properties.name: subHeaderBackgroundColor
properties.description: Hexadecimal IconBadge subheader background only. Text subheaders have no background. Defaults to white independently of the header.
properties.label: Subheader badge background color (hex)

properties.name: showSummary
properties.description: Show summaryText while details are collapsed. Does not control the persistent summary view.
properties.label: Show summary when collapsed

properties.name: summaryText
properties.description: Optional summary text shown while details are collapsed and showSummary is enabled.
properties.label: Collapsed summary

properties.name: summaryViewName
properties.description: Named Pega summary view shown beneath the header in both collapsed and expanded states.
properties.label: Summary view name

properties.name: detailsViewName
properties.description: Named Pega details view loaded only when expanded. Leave blank to omit the toggle.
properties.label: Expanded details view name

properties.name: viewClassName
properties.description: Class of the named views. Defaults to the current case class; specify the class for embedded page views.
properties.label: View class (blank uses current case class)

properties.name: defaultExpanded
properties.description: Initial expansion state. Changing this input resets the current expansion state.
properties.label: Initially expanded

properties.name: allowToggle
properties.description: Allow users to expand and collapse details. Disable for a fixed state set by defaultExpanded.
properties.label: Allow expand and collapse
